Subject: Re: [perl #46047] Not OK: perl v5.6.2 on amd64-freebsd 6.2-release

On 2007–10–03, at 22:00, djzyiw@cpan.org (via RT) wrote:

> t/lib/ipc_sysv.......................semget: No space left on device
> FAILED at test 7
> ext/IPC/SysV/t/sem...................semget: 28 No space left on  
> device
> FAILED at test 1

Are you using a kernel with SYSV semaphore support? You might well  
get this error if you asked a kernel that didn't have it to allocate  
a semaphore for you. I'm not a FreeBSD person, but it appears that  
you need a line in your configuration file in order to get a a kernel  
that is built with them. From :

options          SYSVSEM           # SYSV-style semaphores
Support for System V semaphores. Less commonly used but only adds a  
few hundred bytes to the kernel

-- 
Dominic Dunlop
